main_text.p: tum facientibus, collata. Prius ex Mose desumptum, exhibet nobis canticum, Deo dictante a Viro Dei exceptum, atque in cynosuram omnium prophetiarum sequentium populo Dei traditum, quo viarum Dei, circa Ecclesiam servandarum, teneat compendium, atque articulorum doctrinae propheticae rudimentum. Hujus meditatio Davidi ejusque in poësi sacra coöperariis, saepè materiam praebuit, pluribus sermonibus amplificandam, & pigmentis poeticis ornandam: Prophetis autem varia argumenta (prout temporum ferebat ratio) Spiritu eos incitante penitius inquirenda, novisque circumstantiis (ex novis revelationibus haustis) investienda. Alterum adjeci specimen, ex minorum Prophetarum volumine assumptum; librum nempe HABAKUKI; quo illustremus Prophetarum sequentium methodum, utque illi spem, ex divino hoc cantico conceptam, novis visionum enarrationibus concionibusque, sub certis tentationibus vacillantem, erexerint, & fata populi, in priori delineata, quando opus erat, novo lumine exposuerint: omnia suis accommodantes consiliis, & pro variatione tentationis, nec non rerum exigentia, applicantes.
Haec dum molior, adversus obnitentium praevisa studia me confirmant dicta Petri, 2 Petr. 1: 19-21. quibus Propheticam Scripturam ab utilitate suâ peculiari commendaturus, in hunc modum scribit.

page.notes: Small specks and stains on the scan are not printed text and are left out. The word "sequentiumt" has a faint mark after it; read as "sequentium". The spacing in "exhibet nobis" and "Mose desumptum" is hard to judge on the scan. The long s appears as f in "desumptum" and "investienda" and is transcribed as s. The reference "2 Petr. 1: 19-21." is copied as printed.
